notes: Theorycraft fix (2026-10-31): Lightning Bolt is cast at five Maelstrom Weapon stacks, right after Stormstrike. The engine already modeled the stacks (50% a melee hit, 4% a rank a stack off the next Lightning Bolt's cast time and mana) and Stormstrike's +20% on the next bolt, but no line spent them, so the talent search under-valued Maelstrom Weapon. See design/reviews/2026-10-31-theorycraft-audit/hybrids.md. Vanilla Enhancement at 60: totems dropped before the pull, Stormstrike on cooldown, Searing Totem refreshed -- the rotation search dropped Flame Shock and Earth Shock, which cost more than they returned (the community guide's order is 'totems > Stormstrike > Flame Shock (dot) > Frost/Earth Shock' summary). The fork's enhancement_shaman/apls/default.apl.json is the starting point. Rotation-accuracy program, unused-ability pass (2026-09-28): Flame Shock was named in this very notes paragraph as part of the intended priority but was never actually in the priority list below -- added it as a dot-maintenance line ahead of Searing Totem and Earth Shock, sharing Earth Shock's own 6s shock cooldown (sim/shaman/shocks.go) rather than costing an extra global. Measured on this pinned engine's own ladder (FOREVER_UPDATE_GOLDEN, 300 iterations, seed 1, bare gear/no consumes): level 10 23.1->23.6, 20 38.2->40.0, 30 53.3->56.3, 38 54.2->57.3, 40 61.6->62.4, 50 82.5->86.9, 60 105.4->108.3 DPS -- a gain at every rung, kept per the program's own rule. The one cost: Earth Shock goes idle at level 60 on mana, see expected_idle above. Fix round 1 (CRITICAL, replaces the first pass here): the first pass recast Windfury Totem on `not(auraIsActive({spellId: 10614}))`, reasoning it mirrored Strength of Earth's and Grace of Air's self-referential aura checks. That reasoning was wrong for all three: sim/shaman/air_totems.go registers Windfury's actual buff through a 'trigger dummy' aura with no ActionID set at all, plus a separately-tracked proc aura at SpellID 10611 (a buff-only id, never itself cast, so it does not appear in spellconst) -- no aura on the shaman is ever registered with ActionID.SpellID == 10614, so the old condition resolved to a nil APLValue, which APLAction.IsReady treats as unconditionally true, and Windfury would have been recast on every free GCD forever, starving everything below it in the priority list. Re-checking the same way turned up the identical bug one level deeper: sim/core/buffs.go's StrengthOfEarthTotemAura() and GraceOfAirTotemAura() helpers pick their buff aura's ActionID from IncludeAQ (sim/core/config.go: `const IncludeAQ = true` in this fork) rather than from whatever rank was actually cast -- IncludeAQ forces rank 5 (SpellID 25361) for Strength of Earth and rank 3 (SpellID 25359) for Grace of Air, always, regardless of which rank's totem spell triggered them. Checking auraIsActive against 10442 or 10627, as the preset and the first pass here both did, would have hit the exact same nil-condition bug. Fixed all three by switching to the engine's dedicated primitive for this, sim/shaman/apl_values.go's totemRemainingTime(totemType), which reads shaman.TotemExpirations directly and needs no aura or spell id at all: Strength of Earth against totemRemainingTime(Earth), Windfury against totemRemainingTime(Air). Also dropped Grace of Air Totem entirely rather than 'fix' it in place: it occupies the same Air totem slot as Windfury (sim/shaman/air_totems.go's setActiveAirTotem deactivates whichever air totem was previously active), so with Windfury correctly maintained ahead of it in priority, Grace of Air could now never actually fire -- dead code, not a rotation choice, and the guide's own totem summary calls Windfury 'typically' the air totem for Enhancement anyway. Now that Strength of Earth's buff is confirmed to key off rank 5 (25361), cast that rank directly instead of rank 4 (10442): same totem slot, better stats, no reason to downrank. Also re-verified Searing Totem's dotIsActive(10438) check: sim/shaman/fire_totems.go attaches its Dot directly to the same spell object as its own ActionID (no separate buff-aura helper, unlike the air totems), so that condition was already correct and is unchanged. Stormstrike's rank label was also wrong in the preset -- it cast rank 1, but this build's spellconst has 17364 at rank 0 -- so the rank is dropped entirely here, the same way a rankless spell like Tiger's Fury is written. Reordered autocastOtherCooldowns to be the first priority entry, matching the convention every other spec in this lane follows, instead of after the totem drops as the preset had it. AQ ranks off (2026-10-07): the engine's IncludeAQ is false, so Strength of Earth is rank 4 (10442) again, the highest rank a trainer teaches. Sim audit round 9 (2026-11-02): the Air totem is Grace of Air, not Windfury. The shaman's own Windfury Weapon on the main hand disables any benefit from Windfury Totem, solo there is no group to receive it, and the raid preset's Windfury Totem already covers the group, so the totem bought nothing for its mana and global; Grace of Air from 42 measured about +4% at bands 50 and 60 and on the raid preset (seeds 1 and 50001), and dropping the totem about +0.7% at band 40. Hotfix lane (2026-11-11, design/reviews/2026-11-11-sim-accuracy/hotfixes-other-classes.md): Blizzard's 10 November hotfix made every Maelstrom Weapon stack 20% at every rank, so the line no longer waits for 5/5 (the auraIsKnown gate keeps the talent, without the rank-5 tag): +4.8 to +9.1% at levels 35 to 38, unchanged from 39.

engineering_notes.1: Gated on totemRemainingTime, the engine's own primitive for 'does this totem slot need refreshing.'

priorityList.notes: Strength of Earth Totem whenever it is down: it is Strength for every melee player near you, and in Forever the totem reaches the whole raid within 30 yards.

Grace of Air Totem whenever your Air slot is empty: Agility for every raid member within 30 yards, you included. Take it when another shaman already has Windfury Totem down near the melee: its swings reach you on top of your own Windfury Weapon. If no one does, Windfury Totem is the stronger drop for the warriors and rogues. Learned at 42, rank 2 at 56.
Stormstrike on cooldown: an instant strike that makes your next Lightning Bolt, Chain Lightning or Earth Shock on the target hit 20% harder. 8 second cooldown.

Lightning Bolt at five Maelstrom Weapon stacks: each stack takes 20% off its cast time and mana at any rank, so five make it instant and free from your first point. Cast it right after Stormstrike when you can, so the bolt takes Stormstrike's 20%.
Searing Totem whenever it is down, unless the fight ends within 20 seconds: a fresh totem would barely fire.
Fire Nova on a Clearcasting proc: it is free then, and in melee your Searing Totem stands within its 10 yards of the boss. Clearcasting comes from Elemental Focus in the raid build.

Earth Shock on cooldown while your mana is above about a sixth: once you have Stormstrike it takes Stormstrike's 20% when no bolt is ready. That last sixth keeps Stormstrike and a totem drop paid for; holding a quarter back costs shocks, since after the 10 November hotfix Stormstrike comes every 8 seconds and spends less mana over a fight.

expected_idle.reason: Fire Nova fires on Clearcasting, which needs Elemental Focus; only the raid build takes it, so the leveling build never casts it.

panel_when.1: when your Earth totem is down
panel_when.2: when your Air totem is down
panel_when.5: when Searing Totem is down and the fight has 20+ s left
panel_when.7: on cooldown, above about a sixth of your mana
